subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between D and C. Only G sits to the right of E. Only one person sits between C and E. A sits at some place to the right of F but at some place to the left of B. How many people sit to the right of A?
solution:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only two people sit between D and C.
 
• Only G sits to the right of E.
 
• Only one person sits between C and E.
 
• A sits at some place to the right of F but at some place to the left of B

The final arrangement is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d2549e85ce7e7a0cc50300b0a9bd06c15892bca1abaacb6d599bdcbb3c6d11.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
